build_coco_caption_evaluator: build a COCOCaption metric class to evaluate image caption predictions against COCO ground truth annotations
create_save_result_function: create a function that saves prediction results as a JSON file with optional duplicate removal by key
run_coco_caption_eval: run COCO caption evaluation comparing prediction JSON file against ground truth annotation JSON file
test_process_batch: test the COCOCaption process method to extract pred_caption and image_id from model data samples
review_compute_metrics: review the COCOCaption compute_metrics method that saves results to temp directory and runs COCO evaluation
